Location: Hybrid, Seattle, WA
Level: Senior

Preferred:
- Performance monitoring/profiling

- MLflow or similar model lifecycle management

- High-throughput/low-latency networking

Responsibilities:
- Design, build, operate secure scalable cloud and GPU infrastructure for AI/ML
